Rules that 3.1.0 skipped for suppressed types are not newly reported.","A suppressed type still gets no generated formatter, as in 3.1.0, and no formatter appears in the resolver."],"likelyAreas":["analyzer","generator"],"expectedTests":["A regression test reproducing the issue's sample source expects exactly the diagnostics that 3.1.0 produced.","A generator snapshot test confirms no formatter is emitted for a suppressed type while diagnostics are still reported."]},{"requirementItemId":"N1","expectedBehaviours":["A suppressed type with invalid content, such as conflicting keys, unsupported member types or malformed attribute arguments, makes the analyzer report a diagnostic instead of throwing.","The build shows no AD0001 analyzer exception or generator crash warning (CS8785) for such input.","Diagnostics for other types in the same compilation are still reported when one suppressed type is invalid."],"likelyAreas":["analyzer","generator"],"expectedTests":["An analyzer test with a suppressed type that has malformed or conflicting key attributes asserts the expected diagnostic and no analyzer exception diagnostic.","A test that runs the generator on invalid suppressed input asserts it finishes without exceptions."]},{"requirementItemId":"N2","expectedBehaviours":["Types without SuppressSourceGeneration, or with it set to false, report the same diagnostics as before the change.","Generated formatter and resolver output for non-suppressed types does not change.","No new false positives appear for valid non-suppressed types."],"likelyAreas":["analyzer","generator"],"expectedTests":["The existing analyzer tests for non-suppressed types pass without changes.","The existing generator snapshot tests under Resources pass without changes to the expected files."]}]}
